gauge.name: Canasawacta Creek at Norwich City Line

impacts.statement: Major flood stage. Flooding occurs in the City of Norwich, starting at the west end of Pleasant Street and Willard Court.
Moderate flood stage reached. Additional flooding occurs along State Highway 23 in the Town of Plymouth.
Minor flooding begins along State Highway 23 near the intersection of County Road 16 in Plymouth.

gauge.forecastReliability: Forecasts are not available. Only observed stages are available for this point.
